user.description: Wrap a climate entity to add UI-configured presets. The wrapped entity is fixed once the entry is created — to wrap a different one, delete this entry and add another.

abort.already_configured: This source entity is already wrapped by Magic Climate.

init.title: Magic Climate
init.description:
Each preset below is a temperature band, and Home is the one that moves between them.

By default Home just holds your Comfort band. Switch on Eco and Home splits in two: Comfort outside the peak hours, Eco inside them, swapping on the clock and still reporting Home the whole time. Sleep does the same thing overnight, and Boost runs ahead of peak to pre-heat or pre-cool while power is still cheap.

Whichever way Home is set up, picking any other preset by hand pins that band and holds it until you change it. Leave a window's times blank and its preset is only ever reached that way — created, but never triggered on its own.

This entry wraps {source}; that cannot be changed here — delete the entry and add a new one to wrap a different entity.

comfort.name: Home Comfort
comfort.description: Your standard setting when you are home and want to be comfortable. Home holds this band unless something below moves it.

data_description.fan: Leave unchanged to have the preset not touch the fan.

away.name: Away
away.description: The band to hold when the house is empty. Away has no schedule — you'll need to set up an away trigger in Home Assistant and have it select this preset.

data_description.fan: Leave unchanged to have the preset not touch the fan.

eco.name: Eco energy saver
eco.description: The band to hold when energy costs more — less comfortable, cheaper to run.

data.auto: Home switches between Comfort and Eco at peak time

data_description.auto: Off means Eco exists but nothing applies it — you pick it yourself.
data_description.start: Leave both times blank to trigger Eco manually.
data_description.end: An end earlier than the start means the window runs overnight.
data_description.fan: Leave unchanged to have the preset not touch the fan.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: A band to drive the room past Comfort while power is still cheap, so it coasts through the expensive hours.

data.preload: Pre-heat or pre-cool before peak starts

data_description.preload: Requires Eco with a peak start time set.
data_description.minutes: Minutes before peak to start. How long your rooms actually hold their heat is worth measuring; an hour is only a starting point.
data_description.fan: Leave unchanged to have the preset not touch the fan.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: The overnight band. Sleep outranks peak: if the two overlap, the room stays comfortable to sleep in rather than saving money.

data_description.start: Leave both times blank to trigger Sleep manually.
data_description.end: An end earlier than the start means the window runs overnight, which is usually what you want here.
data_description.fan: Leave unchanged to have the preset not touch the fan.

error.comfort_low_not_below_high: Comfort low temperature must be less than its high temperature.
error.away_low_not_below_high: Away low temperature must be less than its high temperature.
error.eco_low_not_below_high: Eco low temperature must be less than its high temperature.
error.boost_low_not_below_high: Boost low temperature must be less than its high temperature.
error.sleep_low_not_below_high: Sleep low temperature must be less than its high temperature.
error.auto_needs_eco: Create the Eco preset before having Home switch to it.
error.auto_needs_peak_times: Set a peak start and end before having Home switch at peak time.
error.preload_needs_boost: Create the Boost preset before pre-heating or pre-cooling with it.
error.preload_needs_peak: Pre-loading runs up to peak start, so it needs Home switching at a peak time.
error.peak_window_incomplete: Set both peak times, or leave both blank to trigger Eco manually.
error.sleep_window_incomplete: Set both sleep times, or leave both blank to trigger Sleep manually.
